OUR BUSINESS

Temple trips, with a local team.

Heavenly Tours & Travels is a travel agency based in Tirupati / Renigunta, Andhra Pradesh. Owner Hemanth Kumar is your direct contact for planning and confirming a trip.

What we help with

  • Temple trip
  • Group trip
  • Flight tickets
  • Hotel stays
  • Airport / station pickup
  • Local visits / travel to other cities
  • Trip with your own temple stops
  • Driver-operated and self-drive car rentals

Choose from 13 complete, individual and day-wise trips, or ask for a route of your own. We help families, older travellers and groups of 2–200 people.

We only guide you on how to book Tirumala darshan tickets. We do not book tickets for you. Darshan is subject to official availability.

Check current darshan information with Tirumala Tirupati Devasthanams (TTD). Use TTD’s official online services to check ticket availability and book directly. We provide guidance only.

Hours and service areas

Open 24 hours, every day. Our team is based in Tirupati / Renigunta, Andhra Pradesh, India.

Local service areas include Tirupati, Renigunta, Srikalahasti, Gudur, Nellore, Nayudupeta, Venkatagiri, Chennai. We also arrange the listed temple routes across South India and India.

Share your pickup and final drop locations before booking. The owner confirms transport, rooms and availability for your dates.
